target: Native product landing and public beta entry

contract.purpose: Explain Calorie as a private native food and body journal that turns quick logging into transparent timing guidance.
contract.canonicalPurpose: Calorie is a private food and body journal that turns lightweight logging into transparent daily and timing guidance.
contract.audience: A person pursuing weight loss who logs food one-handed and checks progress in short daily moments.
contract.job: Show what to log, how timestamps become fasting, exercise, and sleep estimates, where the app runs, and how current beta access works.
contract.thesis: A calorie total cannot explain the day; visible inputs and rules can provide practical context without becoming an opaque coach.
contract.system: Botanical editorial landing with real iPhone screens, a three-step product loop, fit boundaries, privacy, beta status, project strip, and Ask AI footer.
contract.signature: The real Today screen sits inside a gridded botanical work surface beside the product promise.
contract.risk: Avoid medical certainty, punitive diet language, invented public installation links, and permanent free-or-paid promises.

answers.product: A private local-first food and body journal for iPhone and iPad.
answers.audience: Someone pursuing weight loss who wants fast daily logging without a punitive or opaque diet coach.
answers.value: It connects food, nutrients, water, routines, and weight to useful fasting, exercise, sleep, and progress context.
answers.mechanism: The app uses timestamps, personal targets, and visible formulas or rules rather than an AI coaching layer.
answers.proof: The page uses real native product screens and names the Today, quick-log, Foods, Progress, and settings surfaces.
answers.nextAction: Check the honest internal TestFlight status or inspect the real product screens.

ownerFeedback.note: The owner delegated fleet landing repairs and asked the agent to continue without project-by-project feedback pauses.
